# 13 · Navigation & GNSS

<!-- generated by tools/build.py from curriculum/syllabus.yaml — do not edit -->

How satellite positioning actually works, where its errors come from, what RTK and PPK buy you, the coordinate systems an operator must not confuse, and what to do when the signal is degraded, denied or spoofed.
